# Architecture Design

1. Read approved `docs/plans/requirements.md` and project Copilot instructions. If requirements are not explicitly approved, stop and request the missing prerequisite.
2. Select the simplest stateless design that meets requirements using Python, FastAPI, and HTML/CSS/JavaScript. No database is required or permitted by the approved scope.
3. Create `docs/plans/architecture.md` covering system overview, components and responsibilities, calculation endpoint with inputs/outputs, frontend assets, and request/data flow. There is no persistent data model.
4. Trace design choices to requirement IDs; call out assumptions and unresolved decisions instead of silently deciding material scope.
5. Include a Mermaid diagram of components and their relationships.
6. Do not implement code. Report the artifact and any open decisions to the orchestrator.
